title: Module 12: Two-Layer Neural Network From Scratch
overview: Implemented a two-layer neural network entirely from scratch using NumPy (forward propagation, backpropagation, and gradient descent, with no ML framework) to predict graduate admissions outcomes from GPA, GRE, degree type, and citizenship, reaching 69.5% test accuracy with early stopping.
